selection.ownership: WorkOS, Inc., 548 Market Street, PMB 86125, San Francisco, CA 94104, United States. Public API at api.workos.com. International product, not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Official WorkOS API authentication (Bearer sk_ keys, HTTPS only), GET /organizations, GET /organizations/{id}, GET /user_management/users, GET /user_management/users/{id}, San Francisco operator identity, security/trust pages, and dated incident search for WorkOS / workos.com security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. The 2026-07-16 service disruption was an availability incident with no evidence of unauthorized access or data exposure. No qualifying current unresolved customer-data compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international WorkOS REST API (Composio WORKOS HTTP tools)
research.searchCoverage: Official WorkOS REST API with Bearer sk_ keys at api.workos.com reviewed on 2026-09-13. Operator is WorkOS, Inc., San Francisco. Dated incident search found a 2026-07-16 availability incident with no data exposure, which is not a qualifying unresolved compromise.

incidents.finding: WorkOS published a postmortem for elevated latency and HTTP 5xx across User Management, AuthKit, and SSO from approximately 08:00 to 10:10 UTC. Investigation found no evidence of unauthorized access, data exposure, or corruption of customer data.
incidents.limitation: Availability incidents are retained as historical context and do not qualify as an unresolved customer-data compromise under the 2026-09-13 waiver.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
